notes: Entries are recorded surname-first as printed (except two North Road lines printed forename-first, noted). Continuation lines joined. No separate headings for Newcastle Terrace, Clinton Terrace or Derby Terrace: they are sub-blocks inside DERBY ROAD (p94), carried in Derby Road entries with a 'group' field. NORTH ROAD and SOUTH ROAD each have a second West Bridgford listing (W. B.) immediately after; only the Park ones (district C., Derby road / Lenton road, Park) were transcribed. Clumber Crescent North has no heading in this volume (p165 North Road only lists it as a cross street; p81-82 carry CLUMBER CRESCENT SOUTH only). Derby Road listing transcribed in full (pp94-96) including the Territorial Force HQ block and outlying Lenton/Wollaton houses; site should filter by number. Entries marked 'group' carry a sub-heading such as 'Rock villas', 'Butt houses', 'Brunel terrace'. Tiles given as column crops (c1a = column 1 top half etc.) for pages read that way.
